artworks.title: Horse, Ram, Goat with Kid; In the Distance a Shepherd with Flock
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of farm animals in a pastoral scene. The drawing depicts a group of farm animals, including a horse, goats, and a ram, resting in a grassy area. In the background, there is a figure sitting on a rock. The scene is rich with detail, emphasizing the texture of the animals' fur and the surrounding foliage. The composition is calm and serene, capturing a moment of rest in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Sleeping Old Man with Dog
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person slumped in a reclined position on the left side with their left arm resting on a draped piece of cloth. They have grey hair and a beard and wear a cap, long-sleeved coat, waistcoat, knee-length trousers, and bear feet. They hold a walking stick in their left hand. A dog lies in front of them with its head on its paws. The background consists of trees and foliage, with a jug and bowl on the cloth-draped table beside the person.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Walking Stick and a Peasant Woman with Child
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in the foreground holding a stick. He is wearing a long garment and sandals. Next to him is a goat. In the background, there is a woman holding an infant, and another person partially visible. The setting appears to be outdoors, with vegetation and a landscape visible.

artworks.title: Shepherd Pointing Out the Direction to a Shepherdess
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of farm animals in a pastoral scene. The drawing shows a cow, sheep, and a goat on a path or area. The cow is in the center with other animals around. There is a tree with sparse foliage on the right side, grassy details in the foreground and near the animals.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherdess
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman wearing a long dress with patches of color, sitting with her back partially turned next to a goat. In the background, a flock of sheep are gathered in a field with trees on the left and a wooden fence. The color scheme is mostly gray with occasional warm orange accents. The scene is depicted with detailed lines and shading, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherdess with Three Rams
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three sheep in a pastoral setting. The sheep have textured wool and are surrounded by leafy foliage. In the background, there are hints of vegetation. The style is delicate with intricate details. The setting suggests a peaceful atmosphere. The hatching and shading techniques emphasize texture and depth, enhancing the lifelike appearance of the sheep and vegetation.

artworks.title: Donkey with her Foal, a Dog, and a Peasant Man
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring animals and a figure. The composition shows two donkeys standing on rocky terrain with a small dog lying down in the foreground. To the left is a figure dressed in simple clothing, holding a stick and interacting with the donkeys. The donkeys are detailed, and the dog appears relaxed. The drawing captures a serene and pastoral moment, highlighting the texture of the animals' coats and the natural environment. The background suggests a wide open landscape, enhancing the sense of space and tranquility.

artworks.title: Standing Ox, Two Sheep, and a Goat
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cow, a goat, and a sheep in a pastoral setting. Three animals are resting in an open landscape. A cow stands behind a goat and sheep. The goat lies in the foreground next to the sheep. The surroundings are hinted at with light sketching indicating a natural, grassy landscape with a few shrubs in the background. The drawing style uses detailed line work to create texture and depth in portraying the animals and the scenery.

artworks.title: Sleeping Shepherd, Two Calves, and a Peasant Woman
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cows and two figures in a pastoral setting. The scene depicts two cows standing in a grassy area, with one cow slightly turned towards the other. In the foreground, there is a figure kneeling down, holding a long stick or staff. Another figure stands behind the first one. The landscape is simple, with faint outlines of foliage. The drawing employs a detailed line work technique, suggesting careful attention to texture and shadow.

artworks.title: Shepherd in Repose near a Pack Horse
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pack-laden horse standing over a person lying on the ground. In the foreground, there is a horse with various packs and bags attached to its back, standing calmly with its head lowered slightly. Beneath the horse, a person is lying on the ground, partially obscured by the animal. In the distance, the landscape features a cow on a small hillside, with sparse vegetation scattered around. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic style with intricate shading to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: Boy on a Donkey Driving a Flock
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of sheep with a man riding a donkey slightly behind them. In the background, there is a rustic structure among trees, suggesting a rural setting. The artwork is detailed with stippling and etching techniques, emphasizing textures. The color scheme is muted with shades of gray and earth tones. The sheep have distinctive curled horns, and the background shows faint silhouettes of trees and structures.

artworks.title: Peasant Teasing a Sleeping Girl with a Twig
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals in a pastoral setting with sheep. The image shows two figures, possibly a man and a woman, dressed in period clothing. The man holds a staff and stands near the seated woman, who is focused on something in her hands. On the ground, there are a cylindrical container and a shallow bowl. Two sheep are lying on the grass behind them, with rolling hills and sparse trees in the background. The drawing style features fine lines and shading to emphasize details in the clothing and landscape texture.

artworks.title: Seated Old Man
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: An older man is sitting on a stone in a countryside setting. He leans on his right arm, with one leg crossed over the other. The man has a weathered face, a beard, and wears a large hat. He is dressed in a fur-lined cloak that covers him from shoulders to ankles and holds a staff in his left hand. Next to him is a large cow, resting at his side with its head lowered. Behind him is a young child peeking out. In the background, there are goats grazing on the grass and an old stone archway surrounded by trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Shepherd Speaking to a Peasant Woman
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures and a donkey. On the left, a person is reclining on the donkey. This person wears a hat and has a broad smile. They wear a long-sleeved shirt and pants. To the right, a woman stands with her back to the viewer, wearing a dress, headscarf, and balancing a basket on her head containing a bird. There is a ladder, a stone wall, a small window in the background, and grass and plants in the foreground. The scene is set against a stone building.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Baby and Little Girl
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, an adult and a child. The adult is standing upright holding the child in their arms, while using a walking stick for support. The adult's head is covered with a hood, and their hair is not visible. They are wearing a long robe and shawl. The child is standing slightly in front of the adult, wearing a hooded garment and a long coat. In the background, there is a path with rocks and sparse plants, surrounded by detailed trees and hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman Seated on a Donkey and a Peasant Man
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a pastoral setting. One figure stands on the left holding a walking stick, wearing a hat, long coat, pants, and pointed shoes. The other figure sits on a donkey on the right, dressed in a headscarf and long coat. The rider's arm is slightly bent with one hand pointing forward. The landscape includes a dirt path, small plants, and a large tree in soft tones and intricate detail.

artworks.title: Standing Shepherd
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with sheep. Three sheep are in the foreground, one standing and two lying down, surrounded by foliage. In the background, a person in rustic attire holds a staff. Behind them, there is a figure on horseback in a faint landscape. The drawing uses shading and line work to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: Two Girls Conversing: One Standing and Spinning
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with two women conversing near a rustic wall. In the background, there are distant buildings, ruins, trees, and sheep. The style appears to be an engraving or etching with meticulous lines and shading. The color scheme is mostly muted with some soft orange accents on the women's clothing and sheep. Sheep are resting in the foreground, and the women are engaged in conversation with one holding a distaff. Greenery and structures in the background add depth to the image.

artworks.title: Shepherd with his Flock
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a shepherd with sheep and goats in a pastoral setting. The background has a hill with a few trees. The artwork is a detailed sketch with fine lines defining textures. The color palette is muted with earth tones.

artworks.title: Seated Old Man about to Drink from a Gourd
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older man sitting on the ground, holding a jug with his left hand. He has long hair and a beard, wearing a long-sleeved shirt and loose pants. Next to him on the ground are a sack and a hat. A fluffy dog stands beside him, looking ahead. To the right, a horse with a saddle and a cloak on its back stands. The background displays rocky cliffs and shrubs.

artworks.title: Shepherd with a Sack Driving a Flock
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a shepherd standing among a flock of sheep and goats. The shepherd is wearing traditional attire and holding a staff. A pond is on the left, reflecting some animals. In the background, more sheep are near an archway that appears to be the ruins of a stone structure. Trees and foliage make up the backdrop. The artwork is detailed with fine lines in a monochromatic palette of grays and browns. The brushstrokes show intricate details and texture.

artworks.title: Reclining Shepherd with a Sack
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a rustic scene with various elements positioned on different planes. In the foreground, there is a seated figure with a wide-brimmed hat and a bag slung over their back, facing away. Adjacent is a horse with a pack saddle, angled to the right. Next to the horse is a reclining cow with its head raised, and a dog standing in front. The rough, rocky terrain has sparse vegetation. In the distance, a large rock formation dominates the right, while the left fades into a softer horizon with distant buildings and foliage. The artwork is done in a monochromatic palette with detailed engravings capturing textures and shadows.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherd with a Bull and Bullock
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a man sitting on the ground holding a stick, looking at a large cow nearby. The cow is detailed with realistic fur depicted by intricate brushstrokes. Beside the cow, a calf is resting. In the background, there are sheep standing and lying down. A rocky formation blends into the pale sky, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and brown. A wooden fence and trees are on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Sleeping Peasant and Standing Spinner
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a pastoral setting. One person is seated on the ground with their head resting on a sack. They wear a wide-brimmed hat, a loose-fitting coat, and trousers. The other person stands beside them holding a spindle in their right hand. Their face is covered with a headscarf, and they wear a long-sleeved garment with a wide apron. Nearby are three sheep and a goat, along with a small basket and a stick on the ground. The background features grassy terrain with foliage and a small hill.
